parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The application name. The template applies only when this AppName matches the application name in the ingest URL. The AppName can be up to 255 characters and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). It cannot start with a hyphen or an underscore. Set this parameter to an asterisk (\*) to match all application names.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The primary domain name for live streaming playback.

parameters.name: IgnoreTranscode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to ignore transcoded streams. Valid values:

- **true** (default): Ignore transcoded streams.

- **false**: Do not ignore transcoded streams.

parameters.name: PartDuration
parameters.description:
The duration of a part segment in milliseconds.

> This parameter is required if you set \`Protocol\` to \`LLHLS\_\*\`.

- If SegmentDuration is 1 s, the value can range from 100 to 500 ms.

- If SegmentDuration is 2 s, the value can range from 100 to 1000 ms.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol and container format for live streaming. Valid values:

- **HLS\_CMAF**

- **LLHLS\_TS** (low latency)

- **LLHLS\_CMAF** (low latency)

- **DASH\_CMAF**

- **HLSDASH\_CMAF**

parameters.name: SegmentDuration
parameters.description:
The segment duration in seconds.

- If you set Protocol to HLS\_CMAF, the value can range from 1 to 10 s.

- If you set Protocol to LLHLS\_\*, the value can range from 1 to 2 s.

parameters.name: SegmentNum
parameters.description: The number of M3U8 segments. The value must be an integer from 3 to 10.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The stream name. The template applies only when this StreamName matches the stream name in the ingest URL. The StreamName can be up to 255 characters and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). It cannot start with a hyphen or an underscore. Set this parameter to an asterisk (\*) to match all stream names.
